test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I __took a quick trip__ to my cousin's house before going on vacation to Africa.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Paid a flying visit"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the meaning of the idiom with another example:

 
• **Flying visit* (idiom) *-** a very short visit
